content_zh:
在队伍中间，还有十几辆很大的雪撬车。
每个人都目光精亮，肌肤血色十足，脸上带着骄傲的气息，不像是邪恶之人。
“唉……这里，这里，带我离开这里……”
阳顶天冲了过去，站在他们要经过的道路中间，双手拼命地挥舞呼喊，挡住这支队伍的去路。
这支队伍的武士正在策马奔驰，没有想到一个野人猛地冲出来挡在路中，拼命地挥手呼喊。
“停！”
“武力戒备！”
为首的一名锦袍骑士猛地挥手，顿时整支队伍生生停了下来，然后几十支特殊的弓弩瞬间瞄准了阳顶天。
为首的一名骑士目光如箭盯着阳顶天，冷冷道：“你是谁？为何挡住我们的去路？不怕死吗？”
这是一个非常英武的青年，骑在马上看阳顶天的目光充满了傲气。
阳顶天按捺内心无比的兴奋，喘息了几口，然后装着用毛利人的语言呼喊了几句，这是他的计划，装成毛利野蛮人。
马上的那名骑士还没有回答，从后面一辆华丽的雪橇马车响起一阵清脆悦耳的声音。
“西门炎，为何停下来？前面是谁在大喊大叫。”这是一个非常年轻女子的声音，语速很快，仿佛每个字都充满了不耐烦。
马上那名锦衣骑士的脸色顿时变得无比的恭敬，目光也变得火热迷离，仿佛这个女子的声音每一个字都能击中他的内心，他的名字应该叫作西门炎。
“小姐，是一个毛利野人拦住了我们的去路，我不知道他在说什么？”西门炎火热而又恭敬道。
“毛利野人？现在还有毛利野人，不是已经灭绝了吗？”那个女子不耐烦的声音顿时稍稍有些兴奋，然后道：“我看看！”
然后，她便要推开车门下来。
“焰焰不要下来，这个野人没穿东西，会污浊了你的眼睛。”西门炎赶紧道。
但是已经来不及了，华丽的雪橇马车被推开，一个女子从里面走了下来。
如同一团火焰一般的女孩！阳顶天看了一眼便猛地睁大眼睛，好美丽的女子。

而且，是传说中的童颜美人啊。
精致绝伦的雪白小脸，五官仿佛上天用玉石雕琢一般。绝美的大眼睛水汪汪的却充满了火焰一般的野性，精巧的瑶鼻下，一张红艳艳的樱桃小嘴如同烈火一般。
看这张精致绝美的小脸仿佛只有十几岁，但她的娇躯拥有着已婚女子也无法比拟的傲人曲线。
身材曲线和精致雪白的娃娃脸形成了完全鲜明的反差对比，他明明是个少女，却拥有了如此惊人的身材，便是成熟女子也比不了，真正的绝色娇娃。
她全身上下的衣衫，就算是小靴子都是火红色的，映衬得头发中的宝石玉饰也火红火红的。所以站在雪地上，她真的就如同一团火焰一般，让男人充满了飞蛾扑火的欲望。
那么冷的天气，别人都穿着裘皮毛装，就算看上去很强的西门炎也是如此。唯独这个少女，只穿着薄薄的裹身劲装，却仿佛一点都不怕冷。
她刚刚走出马车的那一刹那，几乎在场所有人的男人目光都迷离了，然后大部分人都自贱惭俗不敢再看，唯独几个英伟傲气的男子继续充满迷醉的目光落在少女的脸上，西门炎便是其中一个。
这个火焰一般的少女下了马车后，充满野性的目光朝阳顶天望来。作为一个女孩，她的目光充满了侵略性，菱角一般的美丽嘴角微微上翘，仿佛随时都充满了不屑和颐指气使。
“这就是野人吗？也没什么好看的。”少女不屑地撇了撇小嘴。
阳顶天此时当然没什么好看的，浑身全赤，头发和胡须都如同杂草一般，不是野人，胜似野人。
最后，少女的目光好奇落在阳顶天的身全身，少许的羞涩的目光很快被野性所掩盖，少女道：“不亏是野人，长得也野兽一般。”
她看阳顶天的目光就真的如同在看野兽一般，仿佛在挑一匹马的目光一般挑挑拣拣，充满了傲气和狂野。
但是西门炎受不了了，他受不了阳顶天的身体被心中女神看到，他觉得这是一种无比强烈的玷污，他顿时大怒，恨不得立刻上前将阳顶天阉割掉。
“好了，野人看完了，用鞭子赶他走，不要拦住我们的去路。”少女清脆道，然后直接上车。
“好！”西门炎一道冷笑，然后拿起鞭子便要猛地朝阳顶天抽来。

content_en:
In the middle of the team, there were a dozen large sleds.
Everyone's eyes are bright, their skin is full of blood, and their faces are proud, and they don't look like evil people.
"Oh...here, here, take me out of here..."
Yang Dingtian rushed over and stood in the middle of the road they were passing through, waving his hands and shouting desperately to block the team's way.
The warriors in this team were galloping on their horses. Unexpectedly, a savage suddenly rushed out and blocked the road, waving and shouting desperately.
"Stop!"
"Force alert!"
A knight in brocade robes at the head waved his hand violently, causing the whole team to stop suddenly, and then dozens of special crossbows were instantly aimed at Yang Dingtian.
The leading knight stared at Yang Dingtian with an arrow-like gaze, and said coldly: "Who are you? Why are you blocking our way? Aren't you afraid of death?"
This is a very heroic young man, looking at Yang Dingtian from a horse with eyes full of arrogance.
Yang Dingtian suppressed the excitement in his heart, took a few breaths, and then pretended to shout a few words in the Maori language. This was his plan, pretending to be a Maori savage.
Before the knight on the horse could answer, a clear and sweet sound sounded from a gorgeous sleigh carriage behind.
"Ximenyan, why did you stop? Who was shouting in front of me?" This was the voice of a very young woman, speaking very fast, as if every word was full of impatience.
Immediately, the knight's face suddenly became extremely respectful, and his eyes became fiery and blurry, as if every word of this woman's voice could hit his heart. His name should be Ximen Yan.
"Miss, it was a Maori savage who blocked our way. I don't know what he was talking about?" Ximen Yan said warmly and respectfully.
"Maori savages? There are still Maori savages now, aren't they extinct?" The woman's impatient voice suddenly became slightly excited, and then said: "Let me see!"
Then, she opened the car door and got out.
"Yanyan, don't come down. This savage is wearing nothing and will stain your eyes." Ximen Yan said quickly.
But it was too late, the gorgeous sleigh carriage was pushed away, and a woman stepped out of it.
A girl who is like a ball of fire! Yang Dingtian took one look and his eyes widened suddenly. What a beautiful woman.
Moreover, she is a legendary child-like beauty.
The exquisite snow-white face, the facial features seem to be carved out of jade by the heavens. The beautiful big eyes are watery but full of wildness like fire. Under the exquisite Yao nose, a bright red cherry mouth is like a blazing fire.
This delicate and beautiful face looks like she is only a teenager, but her delicate body has proud curves that even a married woman cannot match.
The body curves and the delicate snow-white baby face formed a completely sharp contrast. He was obviously a girl, but he had such an amazing figure that even mature women could not compare to. He was a truly stunning girl.
The clothes all over her body, even her little boots, were all fiery red, which made the gems and jade ornaments in her hair look fiery red. So standing on the snow, she was really like a ball of flame, filling men with the desire of moths to fly into the flame.
In such a cold weather, everyone else is wearing fur clothes, even Ximenitis who looks very strong. Only this girl, wearing only a thin body-hugging outfit, seemed not to be afraid of the cold at all.
The moment she stepped out of the carriage, the eyes of almost all the men present were blurred, and then most of them were too ashamed to look at her anymore. Only a few majestic and arrogant men continued to cast their intoxicated eyes on the girl's face, and Ximen Yan was one of them.
After the flaming girl got off the carriage, her wild eyes looked towards the sun. As a girl, her eyes are full of aggression, and the corners of her beautiful water chestnut-like mouth are slightly upward, as if she is full of energy at any time.Full of disdain and bossiness.
"Is this a savage? There's nothing interesting to see." The girl curled her lips disdainfully.
Yang Dingtian certainly didn't look good at this time. He was completely red, and his hair and beard were like weeds. He was not a savage, but better than a savage.
Finally, the girl's eyes curiously fell on Yang Dingtian's body, and her shy look was quickly covered up by her wildness. The girl said: "He is a savage after all, and he looks like a beast."
The way she looked at Yang Dingtian was really like looking at a wild beast, as if she were choosing a horse, full of arrogance and wildness.
But Ximen Yan couldn't stand it anymore. He couldn't stand Yang Dingtian's body being seen by the goddess in his heart. He felt that this was an extremely strong defilement. He was furious and wanted to go forward and castrate Yang Dingtian immediately.
"Okay, the savage has finished reading. Use a whip to drive him away. Don't block our way." The girl said crisply, and then got in the car directly.
"Okay!" Ximen Yan sneered, then picked up the whip and whipped it towards the sky.
